impact.text: Red-Black Tree maintains stale price levels

precondition_sources.text: Orders at a price level expire while the price level remains alive in the tree.

intent_sources.text: When expired orders are removed, price level cleanup must remove the level from the tree if all remaining orders at that level are also expired.
